name: Photo Reviews Gallery
summary: Responsive gallery of target-supplied review images that remains passive unless a target provides native actions.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated square media item, passive by default or rendered as a native action by the target.

anatomy.name: image
anatomy.description: Review image that fills its contained square item.

anatomy.name: imageFallback
anatomy.description: Compatibility selector for direct image children that do not yet use the explicit image class.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Generated fine-pointer feedback overlay for target-supplied native actions.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional accessible region name when surrounding content does not already identify the gallery.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Ordered target-owned image items, alt text, and any native link or button semantics.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Auto-filling grid contained by available inline width.

states.name: default
states.description: Responsive gallery with passive items by default.

states.name: actionHover
states.description: Fine-pointer feedback only when the target renders a native action.

states.name: actionFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus for a target-supplied native action.

behavior.name: passiveByDefault
behavior.description: Items are passive media unless a target explicitly renders native link or button semantics. The neutral gallery does not own a lightbox.

behavior.name: imageAlternative
behavior.description: Targets provide meaningful alt text for informative review images and empty alt text only for genuinely decorative duplicates.

accessibility: Provide meaningful alt text for informative review images and empty alt text only for decorative duplicates.
Use native links or buttons when a target makes an image actionable; do not make a div click-only.
Preserve visible focus and an accessible name for every target-supplied action.
Do not communicate review information only through hover or generated overlays.
Any modal or lightbox focus management and dismissal belongs to the component selected by the target.

web.notes: Responsive containment, native-action focus, fine-pointer hover, forced-colors, and reduced motion are implemented.

shopify.notes: A future adapter must select image data and any action/lightbox composition explicitly.
